*Tom Felton & Emma Watson*

Tom Felton played Draco Malfoy. Emma Watson played Hermione Granger. On screen: enemies. Off screen: family.
They met when they were 11 on the set of _Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone_ and grew up together over 10 years of filming.  
What we know:
- They’ve always called each other close friends
- Tom has said Emma was like a "little sister" to him on set
- Emma called Tom one of her first crushes in a 2011 interview
- They still support each other - Tom came to Emma's book events, Emma posts about Tom's art and music

No, they never dated. Yes, the chemistry was real. Yes, we’re still not over it.

Enemies to... best friends for life.

They spent their entire childhoods together at Hogwarts. Well, on a film set. Same thing.  
Tom was the protector older brother energy. Emma was the smart one keeping everyone in line.  

*Proof they’re soulmates as friends:*
- Tom: "Emma was my first crush" 
- Emma: "Tom took care of me"
- Both: _proceed to be the most supportive of each other for 20+ years_

We ship Dramione. But we respect Tomione - the real life friendship that raised us.

*Dobby’s Death in Deathly Hallows Part 1* 

It’s one of the most emotional moments in the whole series 💔

*What happened:*  
Harry, Ron, Hermione + others get captured and locked in Malfoy Manor’s cellar by Snatchers. Dobby hears Harry’s call through the shard of Sirius’s mirror. 

He apparates into the cellar, frees everyone, and starts disapparating them to Shell Cottage one by one. 

Right before they escape, Bellatrix Lestrange throws a silver knife. Dobby turns to catch it so it won’t hit Harry. The knife hits Dobby in the chest instead.

*Last words:*  
Dobby looks at Harry and says “Harry Potter…” with a small smile. Then he dies in Harry’s arms, free.

*Why it hits hard:*  
1. *He died free*: No master, no orders. He chose to come save Harry. 
2. *He died saving friends*: Same way he lived - putting others first. 
3. *The burial*: Harry digs his grave by hand on the beach. No magic. “Here lies Dobby, a Free Elf”. Harry says Dobby was more of a man than many wizards.

*Quote that breaks you:* “Such a beautiful place… to be with friends. Dobby is happy to be with his friend, Harry Potter.”

Dobby proves heroes don’t need wands or power. Just courage + love.
